children: Jan Erik Hoff has been permanently appointed Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of Kongsberg Maritime ASA and joins the Executive Management Team. Hoff has served in the role on an interim basis since June this year.

Jan Erik Hoff brings extensive experience from Kongsberg Gruppen, including serving as Group Vice President, Investor Relations. Following Kongsberg Maritime's stock market listing in April, he assumed responsibility for Investor Relations and Business Intelligence within Kongsberg Maritime and has served as acting CFO since 18 June.

"I am excited to take on the role of Chief Financial Officer of Kongsberg Maritime. We are uniquely positioned through our world-leading technology, strong market presence and talented people. I look forward to continuing the course set by Mette and working closely with colleagues across the organisation to realise the significant opportunities that lie ahead of us," says Hoff.

Mette Toft Bjørgen, who has served as CFO since the company was listed on the stock market in April this year, has decided to step down from the role and leave Kongsberg Maritime. Prior to the demerger and stock market listing in April, she served as Chief Financial Officer of Kongsberg Gruppen.

"It has been an exciting journey to be part of the process of listing Kongsberg Maritime. I am impressed by the dedication and commitment shown by our employees throughout this period, and I will certainly follow the company’s continued development with great interest," says Toft Bjørgen.
Kongsberg Maritime CEO Lisa Edvardsen Haugan extends her sincere thanks to Toft Bjørgen for the pivotal contribution she made to the company's stock market listing and in the period that followed.

"Mette was invaluable to us during our stock market listing. Before that, I also had the pleasure of working with her as part of Kongsberg Gruppen's Executive Management Team. I will miss Mette and wish her every success in the future.

Jan Erik knows our company exceptionally well and understands what it takes for us to deliver on our highly ambitious plans. He has demonstrated this during his time as acting CFO, and I am delighted to welcome him into the role on a permanent basis," says Edvardsen Haugan.
Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology.

We deliver advanced solutions to merchant, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea.
Today, over 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board.
Kongsberg Maritime has over 8,400 employees in 35 countries.

title: Jan Erik Hoff appointed CFO of Kongsberg Maritime
